rules.name: Objective Completion
rules.desc: All success criteria defined in the Locked Goal and Execution Specification are satisfied.

rules.name: Independent Verification Passed
rules.desc: Verification must be performed by Tester or Consolidator, never by the authoring worker.

rules.name: Zero Unresolved Auto-Fails
rules.desc: No auto-fail triggers remain active or unaddressed.

rules.name: Evidence Complete
rules.desc: Every assertion and generated artifact is backed by verifiable evidence.

rules.name: Format Compliant
rules.desc: Output strictly validates against the schema defined in the role contract.

rules.name: No Silent Requirement Drops
rules.desc: Every requirement in the input bundle is either completely fulfilled or declared in unresolved_gaps with rationale.

rules.name: Non-Self-Assessment Enforced
rules.desc: Authoring worker has not graded, scored, or summarized its own performance.
